scope: Vertical singlet TDDFT on an independently Hessian-checked GFN2/ALPB geometry; no DFT optimized-geometry claim
auxiliary_basis: PySCF method-dependent default, expanded basis recorded in manifest
required_follow_up: basis, quadrature, solvent and geometry sensitivity
experimental spectrum under matched chemical state and conditions
limitations: GFN2/ALPB geometry is not a DFT minimum
One conformer is not a validated solution ensemble
Positive oscillator strengths and converged eigenvalues do not validate experimental band assignments
C-PCM does not include SMD non-electrostatic terms
No absolute measured absorbance or empirical line widths are inferred
